project_info.theme: 7-seater ownership offer with insurance and financing support
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, White, Deep Blue, Orange, Fresh Green

main_subject.detail: Two white Toyota 7-seater models, Avanza Premio on the left and Veloz Cross on the right, are parked on a lakeside park road beneath a pale blue sky, while giant offer numbers and financing text dominate the upper half.
main_subject.style: Photoreal promotional automotive composite with airy daytime scenery, oversized offer typography, and glossy catalog-grade vehicle rendering.

items: Top Left: Black Toyota logo on light sky background.
Top Center: Mixed orange uppercase and blue handwritten-style headline with a painterly underline stroke.
Bottom Left: White Avanza Premio in front three-quarter view with insurance offer block above it.
Bottom Right: White Veloz Cross in front three-quarter view, larger than the Avanza, with handwritten 'Move your world' in white script.
Center/Background: Soft park lake, tree line, bright lawn, and three-column pricing/benefit structure featuring giant blue '0%' and giant orange '100%'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even daylight, crisp car reflections, soft atmospheric haze in the distance, glossy headline effects, and clean sales-poster clarity.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Toyota 7-seater ownership offers. Centerpiece is a pair of white Toyota family MPVs, Avanza Premio and Veloz Cross, parked on a scenic park road by a lake under a pale blue sky. Background is a bright landscaped park with trees and water. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo at top left, large Vietnamese sales headline 'RUOC BO DOI 7 CHO' and 'So huu GOI BAO VE TOAN DIEN', benefit block for 1-year body insurance, giant blue '0% /NAM', giant orange '100% LE PHI TRUOC BA', and small footer date line '01/07/2026 - 31/07/2026'. Technical style: photorealistic promotional automotive poster, bright natural park daylight, glossy headline effects, clean sales-poster clarity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Toyota corporate logo black version
assets.usage: Place at top left exactly as in the creative.

assets.name: Toyota Avanza Premio white exterior reference
assets.usage: Use for the smaller left vehicle with correct grille and proportions.

assets.name: Toyota Veloz Cross white exterior reference
assets.usage: Use for the larger right vehicle with sharper front fascia and wheel details.

assets.name: Park lake road background
assets.usage: Recreate calm green park, lake, and open sky.

assets.name: Offer typography and three-column incentive layout
assets.usage: Preserve exact date range, giant '0%' and '100%' scale, and blue script/orange uppercase headline mix.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The date line '01/07/2026 - 31/07/2026' is an active July 2026 campaign window relative to Friday, July 17, 2026; preserve it exactly. Keep the Veloz Cross larger and closer to camera than the Avanza Premio. The mood should be optimistic and open-air, not urban or studio-based.
